summary: Prepare for the PECB ISO 13485 Lead Auditor exam with five days of MDQMS audit training, practical exercises, and structured exam preparation.
audienceIntro: This ISO 13485 Lead Auditor course is for professionals who audit, maintain, or advise on medical devices quality management systems and need structured audit preparation.
prerequisites: PECB lists a fundamental understanding of ISO 13485 and comprehensive knowledge of audit principles as prerequisites for this training course.
